summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 2 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.6/2)

data.turoyo: əzzi manṭanwo i agono mə gabayye, w i šərtan biya, w hawxa dayfinawola. Dayfinawola nəfqiwa ad dawġe,
data.translation: Ich ging und holte die Tonschale bei ihnen ab. (Wir gaben) die Joghurtkugeln hinein und rieben sie darin hin und her. Wir rieben sie und dann entstand Dickmilch daraus.

rationale: First technical sense and first Infectum-wa box; single context contains curd, bowl, both verb tokens and product.

summary: New sense 2: (Quarkkugeln) durch Reiben verarbeiten, verrühren (zur Herstellung von dawġe)

data.gloss: (Quarkkugeln) durch Reiben verarbeiten, verrühren (zur Herstellung von dawġe)

rationale: The curd is acted on in a bowl and dawġe results; no body or other surface is coated. This differs from inherited bestreichen. One verse with two repeated tokens; exact rehydration procedure remains a question.

summary: New I Infectum-wa dayfinawola is habitual 1pl with a feminine patient suffix. The repeated token is represented in one example, not counted as independent corroboration.
The curd i šərtan is resumed by -la; biya identifies the bowl as location. Resulting ad dawġe is subject of following nəfqiwa, not a second object of dyf.
Contrast inherited Preterit: unmarked water and salt are the applied substance, l-marked body the surface. The new cooking use changes the operation and construction, not merely the patient.
PrS 32/8 is the existing example cited as prs 80/4; suppress duplicate addition and preserve the inherited wording and citation.
What physical operation does dayf- name here: rubbing, mixing, dispersing or rehydrating? No water addition is explicit in this verse, so do not build it into the gloss.
Does the reported šyf parallel in the next verse denote the same operation? That verse is not supplied in this job and was not used as independent evidence.
